visual.name: atlasFlow
visual.description: Sankey, chord and network diagrams in one visual, with flat, soft and 3D looks and a palette that follows your report theme, a brand color or your own colors.

en-US.Landing_Line1: Add a Source, a Target and a Weight to draw a Sankey, chord or network.
en-US.Landing_Line2: Pick the chart type, look and palette in the Format pane.
en-US.Warn_Loops_Text: Flows that return to an earlier stage are left out of the Sankey. Switch to Chord or Network to see them.
en-US.Warn_Limit_Text: There are more source and target pairs than the visual can show. Filter the report to see the rest.
en-US.Mark_Selected: Selected: this visual is filtering other visuals
en-US.Mark_Filter: This visual is filtering the report
en-US.Mark_Highlighted: Highlighted by a selection in another visual

dataRoles.name: source
dataRoles.description: Where each flow starts (for example traffic source, From, Previous brand)

dataRoles.name: target
dataRoles.description: Where each flow ends (for example landing page, To, Current brand)

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Extra values to show in tooltips
